real_gap.title: Real gap found — 120 destinations (109 tier-A) have no emergency-SOS block, and they render NOTHING (not even universal helplines)
paragraphs: Ground-truthed directly against the database: the SOS data lives at deep_dive.local_helpers. 405 of 525 destinations have that block and every one of the 405 carries at least one dialable phone (zero malformed or placeholder numbers). The gap is the other 120 — 23% of the catalogue — which have no block at all. 109 of those 120 are content-tier A, i.e. the high-traffic destinations.

The user-facing severity is sharpened by a rendering behaviour: when the block is absent the page renders no SOS section whatsoever — not even the universal national helplines (112/100/108). So on these 120 pages the emergency surface is a dead end. Today's random sample happened to hit five of them (lonavala, morjim, tiruvannamalai, manimahesh-kailash, nagarhole), four tier-A.

This corrects yesterday's report, which stated '480 have an emergency_sos row, only 45 with no row.' There is no emergency_sos row/table; that number was a mis-measurement. Recommended fix order: (1) cheap + universal — always render 112/100/108 even when local_helpers is missing, so no page is a dead end; (2) backfill the 109 tier-A destinations from authoritative .gov.in / .nic.in district control-room + hospital sources, never fabricating a number.

The 109 tier-A gap is geographically clustered — overwhelmingly Maharashtra, Karnataka, Goa and a band of Tamil Nadu pilgrimage towns — which points to an incomplete SOS rollout for those state clusters rather than scattered omissions (the same north-to-south pattern the eateries/stays backfill followed). High-traffic names in the gap make this urgent: metros mumbai, bengaluru, pune, nagpur, mysore; marquee tourist sites hampi, coorg, mahabaleshwar, lonavala, matheran, gokarna and most of the Goa beaches; and tier-A pilgrimage anchors shirdi, tirumala, katra, palani, swamimalai, tiruvannamalai.

Full tier-A gap list (109) for the backfill queue: agonda, aihole, ajanta-caves, alibaug, amboli, anjuna, arambol, assagao, astavinayak-circuit, aurangabad, badami, bandipur, belur, bengaluru, bhandardara, bhimashankar, bidar, bijapur, borra-caves, calangute-baga, candolim, chikmagalur, chitradurga, chorao-divar, colva-benaulim, coorg, dandeli, daulatabad, dharmasthala, dudhsagar-falls, elephanta-caves, ellora-caves, fort-aguada, ganpatipule, gokarna, gulbarga, halebidu, hampi, harihareshwar, igatpuri, jog-falls, kabini, kanheri-caves, karla-bhaja-caves, karwar, kashid, katra, khandala, kolad, kolhapur, kukke-subramanya, lenyadri, lonar-crater, lonavala, mahabaleshwar, mahad-raigad, malvan, mandrem, mangalore, mansarovar-kailash, margao, matheran, mollem, morgaon, morjim, mumbai, murud-janjira, murudeshwar, mysore, nagarhole, nagpur, nandi-hills, nashik, old-goa, ozar, palani, pali-raigad, palolem, panaji, panchgani, pattadakal, pazhamudircholai, pench-maharashtra, ponda-spice, pune, raigad-fort, ranjangaon, ratnagiri, reis-magos, sakleshpur, satara, shirdi, shravanabelagola, shrikhand-mahadev, siddhatek, siolim, srirangapatna, swamimalai, tadoba, tarkarli, theur, tiruchendur, tirumala, tiruparankundram, tiruttani, tiruvannamalai, trimbakeshwar, udupi, vagator.
